svg.text: THE YAAD TRUST ENGINE · Agentic Workflow v6
Revision 6, 7 September 2026. Supersedes v5 of 3 August 2026, which is kept alongside it. AI coordinates, verifies and drafts. A named human decides every money and trust step.
Three structural corrections in this revision, marked NEW IN v6 where they appear: Yaadly is the principal contractor · nothing auto releases · the two sign-offs are separated. Full note at the foot.
AI Agent
Human decides
Data / API
Changed in v6
LIVE SURFACES, ONE SPINE:
WhatsApp over Twilio, the conversation (client thread and worker thread, never shared) · app.yaadly.co.uk, client and worker portals
yaadly.co.uk, the public site and the published price guide · concierge.yaadly.co.uk, the admin desk behind Cloudflare Access, where a named person takes every consequential decision
INPUT · Client
WhatsApp, web form, email or portal.
Text, photos, or a Patois voice note,
transcribed. JDPA and UK GDPR consent.
1 · INTAKE AGENT
Voice, photo or text to a Job Card
+ JOB TYPE assigned at intake
3 questions max. No price, no date.
2 · PRICING AGENT
Fair price band per service and parish.
A lookup, never a generated number.
"No public price exists" is a full answer
DATA · Price bands + supply registry
Bands researched and seeded · every reviewed quote is
kept, so the price database fills at the rate the business
runs · registry: all three lanes, tiers, ratings, availability
JOB TYPE REGISTRY, the workflow is data and not code (type = state chain + evidence checklist + release trigger + aftercare rule)
REPAIR AND BUILD: the full loop below, 28 day warranty window · INSPECTION AND REPORT: the report IS the deliverable, and the client confirms RECEIPT AND COVERAGE,
never the verdict · PROPERTY CARE: recurring inspection visits, the same zone checklist every time, issues raise a child Repair job
PM AND OVERSIGHT: judgment work (scope, sequencing, quote shape, evidence), never price estimation, which is quantity surveying and sits outside the service boundary

Types COMPOSE: an inspection point on a Repair or Project job is a child Inspection track job, with its own independent inspector, its own checklist and its own payment. A new service is a new registry row, not a new build.
SUPPLY, THREE LANES, ONE TRUST CURRENCY (skills first, papers only where the law demands)
TRADESPEOPLE (do). Certified: credential verified against the issuing body (HEART, licensing) and regulated trades unlocked · Uncertified: identity checked, then a sandbox tier of
micro jobs rising on rated work, where a dip retrains rather than banishes. Both lanes file exactly the same evidence.
INSPECTORS (see). Independent by rule: never the worker on the job they check · certification free, recovered through commission · paid on report delivery, never on the verdict
PROFESSIONALS (judge). Qualified PMs vetted against founder built playbooks · per PM cover · the guarantee boundary travels with the lane · a Yaad Score variant per lane
IDENTITY:
the government photo ID, the live selfie and the face video go to Persona and to a named person at Yaadly, and to nothing else. No model ever sees them, enforced in code before the file is
fetched from storage, with no override. Supporting paperwork reaches a model only where the applicant gave explicit consent, and a blank answer counts as declined.
NEW IN v6
THE STRUCTURE, SETTLED 3 SEPTEMBER 2026: YAADLY IS THE PRINCIPAL CONTRACTOR AND HOLDS NOBODY'S MONEY.
A MANAGED JOB. The client buys the job from Yaadly at one agreed price. Yaadly engages an identity checked tradesperson as its own subcontractor and pays him under its own
separate agreement. The client never contracts with him and never pays him. If the work is wrong the client comes to Yaadly, not to a stranger in Jamaica, and putting it right is Yaadly's.
OVERSIGHT ONLY. The client's own contractor stays theirs and they pay him directly. Yaadly holds none of the money for the building work and never pays that contractor. What the
client buys is the eyes: somebody qualified attends, records what is there against a checklist, and writes it up. Yaadly's own fee for that is invoiced separately.

There is no account with a client's money sitting in it waiting for a button to be pressed. v5 drew this box as "funds held with a licensed payment provider" and that was the single largest error in it.

Yaadly does not operate an escrow service. The word is banned in both runtimes, along with any wording that implies Yaadly holds money for anybody, and the language screen checks every outbound message.
API · Payment rails
At or under £500: card authorised at
booking, charged once the work is done
and accepted · Above £500: invoice and
bank transfer · payout by bank or Lynk
HUMAN · The client accepts the quote
One price, agreed in writing before anything starts, already including the
15% Guarantee and Support fee, on labour only and never on materials.
Yaadly engages the worker at his own agreed price less 12%, written into his
engagement note before he accepts. Both figures shown before either agrees.
DECISION · Routing
Split by value, duration and
job type. AI ranks, a person
picks. Never pay for placement,
and never a charge to quote.
DATA · The written terms
Payment terms are agreed in writing for
each job before anything starts: what
each stage covers, and what has to be
finished for that stage to count as done.
NEW IN v6
THE STAGED LADDER, matched to real trade practice (founder decision, 28 August 2026).
A0 · one to two days, materials nil or trivial. NOTHING up front. Paid in full on completion against approved evidence. No retention. If there is nothing to buy, do not take a deposit.
FAST TRACK, at or under £500. Materials on receipt, then 100% of the labour on approved evidence. No retention. This is the December pilot scope.
£500 to £2,000. Materials on receipt · 40% of the labour at a signed off midpoint · 60% on completion · 5% retention, released on day 28 as the warranty window closes.
PROJECT TRACK, £2,000 and above. Sub milestones capped at £500 to £1,000 · materials per milestone · an inspection point before each release.

Materials always pass through at cost, against a receipt, and are never marked up. Retention is 5% and only above £500, where v5 said 10%: it is the worker's own money and it is skin in the game, not a repair fund.
THE ARRIVAL LOG AND SITE MATCH GATE (before a tool is lifted, and it is the worker's first protection, not the client's)

The worker or inspector arrives, files a wide pan video, close ups and a location he chooses to share, BEFORE touching anything. That arms the guarantee and defeats a false damage claim. Then a choice:
SITE MATCHES, which unlocks the materials tranche if there is one and work begins | DOESN'T MATCH, which raises a variation with video grounds, and the client approves the true price,

or the worker cancels penalty free, no strike and no mark, plus a flat call out fee. It is never the worker's job to finish a job that lied about itself. Arrival is checked against the job's parish, never geocoded to the street address.
INPUT · Midnight Work-Log
No daytime tracking. One package by
11:59pm JA: pan, close up anchors, text
summary, materials receipts. Filed straight
from WhatsApp, no portal visit needed.
3 · VERIFICATION AGENT
Checks completeness, sequencing and
plausibility across the whole chain, against
the JOB TYPE's own checklist. Assembles a
pack for a person. Flags only. Never rules.
INSPECTION POINT (optional, per milestone): an independent critique of the work itself
A child Inspection track job on the parent. An independent inspector visits and critiques the work against the scope.
Visual £40 to £60 · technical £50 · in depth certified £250 to £400 per milestone at scale stage. The client pays for it.
The checker is NEVER the worker on that job, and the inspector is paid on delivering the report, never on its verdict.
On the Project Track a milestone can be gated on this sign off. An audit is a system raised inspection point.
5 · REPORTING AGENT
Drafts the Completion or Inspection
Report PDF from the evidence: summary,
photographs in their sections, verification
record. The doer writes no paperwork.
It describes, and it never approves.
HUMAN · The doer confirms
The worker or inspector reads the draft:
"what is written is what was done", then
confirms. His name, his word. Nothing
travels in his name without it. Timeout,
chase and escalation are all to a person.
HUMAN · Yaadly checks the work
A named person at Yaadly checks the evidence
against the agreed scope and makes the payment
call. THIS is what pays the tradesperson.
He is Yaadly's subcontractor, so he is never left
waiting on a client abroad for his own money.
HUMAN · The client signs off
From the portal, a logged WhatsApp reply, or a
tap carrying that job's own code. THIS closes the
stage with Yaadly and makes the balance due to
Yaadly. On an inspection it confirms receipt and
coverage of the report, never its verdict.
NEW IN v6
TWO SIGN-OFFS, TWO DIFFERENT JOBS. v5 drew them as one chain, and that is the correction that matters most in this revision.
Yaadly's check is what pays the tradesperson, within 3 working days, by bank transfer, Lynk wallet or remittance pick up · the client's sign off is what closes the stage with Yaadly and
makes the balance due · the two are deliberately decoupled, because a worker in Portmore should not wait on a client in London to be paid for work that has already been checked.
NOTHING AUTO RELEASES. v5 showed a 48 hour auto release in three places. It is gone. Nothing is paid because a countdown ran out, a score passed, or a check went green.
BRANCH · Free complaint
No cost to raise, and raised before the
client accepts the work. Nothing further
is paid out on the job while it is open.
Defects pinned to specific evidence.
HUMAN · Day 3 site survey
An independent ground partner on site
by day 3: unedited macro video of the
pinned zone. The fee is fronted from
Yaadly's own guarantee reserve.
HUMAN · Day 7 ruling
Reviewed by a person, never by an algorithm. The
tradesperson gets a fair chance to make it right first.
On a managed job, putting it right is Yaadly's
responsibility. A worker never owes Yaadly money.
4 · EVIDENCE AGENT
Assembles the pack the ruling is made from, and
drafts neutral, dignity preserving worker comms.
A pack is a recommendation and never a ruling.
Dispute ruling logic does not exist, by design.
OUTPUTS, what every verified job produces:
Payment within 3 working days · a signed Completion Report PDF (the doer's confirmation, the client's approval and the payment record, the client's permanent copy) · a row in the price database
· two way blind reviews · and the YAAD SCORE, one trust currency with three ways to earn it: a tradesperson's completed jobs, an inspector's accepted reports, a PM's delivered engagements.

A portable financial record, exported only with the worker's consent, for credit unions, banks and mortgages. Yaadly is the data source, never the lender. Not computed yet: out of scope until after the pilot.
THE DATA FLYWHEEL:
a verified job makes a complete record, which makes better bands, matching and verification, and so more trust and more jobs. Lead generation rivals never see the transaction.

GOVERNING RULES: AI intakes, prices, verifies, drafts and ranks. It never releases money, rules on a dispute, or alters a reputation, and a named human confirms every consequential step. Seven actions are reserved to a

person in code, not in a prompt: release funds, withhold funds, refund client, rule on dispute, adjust Yaad Score, suspend worker, approve job · Yaadly is the principal contractor and holds nobody's money · the client funds

materials at cost, never marked up · logging delays never punish workers, it is a reminder and a grace period · a worker can lose a job's earnings but can never owe the platform money · skills first entry, papers only where

the law demands · no one outranks the evidence · JDPA and UK GDPR consent, export and erasure built into the core · every report is AI drafted, doer confirmed and human reviewed, in that order, always.
MIRROR RULE:

every protection has a named counterpart. The worker is paid within 3 working days of Yaadly's own check ↔ the client owes Yaadly nothing until they have seen the evidence and said the work is right ·

the worker walks away penalty free from a site that was mis-sold ↔ a no show is a strike and an instant client rematch · no worker debt ↔ a client gets the fault put right first, free · nothing travels in the doer's name

without his word ↔ his silence never stalls somebody else's money · the inspector is paid on delivery and coverage, never on the verdict ↔ the checker is never the worker. Nobody carries the risk alone.
WHAT CHANGED FROM v5 (3 August 2026) TO v6 (7 September 2026). v5 is kept alongside this drawing rather than replaced, so the change is auditable.
1. The structure. v5 said funds were "held with a licensed payment provider" and drew a client funding step before work. From 3 September 2026 Yaadly is the principal contractor and holds nobody's
money. That phrase is now banned in both runtimes, and it is the one banned idea a word list could not catch, because no single word in it is banned.
2. The auto release. v5 showed a 48 hour auto release on accepted evidence, in three places. Nothing auto releases. A named person makes every payment call, and no countdown, confidence score or
green check does it instead. 3. The two sign-offs. v5 drew one chain in which client approval paid the worker. They are now separate: Yaadly's check pays the worker, the client's sign-off
closes the stage with Yaadly. Also corrected: retention 10% becomes 5% and only above £500 · payout "24 hours" becomes 3 working days · the staged ladder now matches the 28 August decision.
